title: Partnership programme for designers and architects
excerpt: DADO launches a partnership programme for interior designers and architects: a sample library, project consultations and the option to meet clients in the showroom.
body:
Over twenty years of work, most of our clients have come back with repeat orders, largely the result of working with designers and architects. We have now shaped this cooperation into a structured programme.

For programme members, a dedicated sample library has been set up in the showroom. All colours and finishes of the CROWN, ROMA and TORRA collections are available as small samples that can be taken to show a client.

A specialist is assigned to every project. They help with format, laying pattern, quantity calculation and delivery timing. Technical data on the collections is provided in digital form.

Our showroom is open for meetings between a designer and their client. The collections you need are prepared for the agreed time, and on request our specialist joins the meeting.

To join the programme, send a short email to info@dadoceramics.uz or call +998 78 150 00 02. Participation is free.
